scope: Independent numerical and case solutions; inputs read from student prompts, values calculated independently without evaluating registry expressions

unregistered.units: Percentages use original ten-seed denominator per tray; length-change rates cm/day, not biomass rates. Equal seed counts make mean tray percentage equal pooled percentage; general unequal-count means require care.

task_solutions.GD1: Water imbibition can swell a seed without new tissue. Irreversible division/expansion versus differentiation/maturity; elongation can coexist with reserve respiration and declining entire-seedling dry mass. Length does not establish health or biomass.
task_solutions.GD2: Viable intrinsic dormant block versus viable quiescence because external conditions lack versus nonviability. Impermeable coat/conceptual scarification, physiological dormancy/species-appropriate stratification or after-ripening, immature embryo/maturation are qualified cases. Seven days without emergence does not distinguish them. No pupil treatments.
task_solutions.GD3: A/B water comparison; A/C recorded temperature comparison with matched moisture; same lot/random allocation/three independent trays of ten each. Ventilation is shared, no isolated oxygen trial; light held comparable, not tested. Radicle >=2 mm is a declared local criterion, not every species universal definition. Teacher packet window and daily observations, not fixed predicted temperature outcome.
task_solutions.GD4: Nine actual labelled replicate trays/90 seeds and actual daily raw record with temperature, moisture/water addition, new and cumulative counts, missingness and observer. Adult between-lesson oversight and mould isolation/disposal; learner named actions require observation, not a group plan.
task_solutions.GD5: A 80/90/70%, pooled and mean80%; B0/10/0%, pooled and mean10/3%; C30/40/20%, pooled and mean30%. A-B=230/3 percentage points, A-C50. Three tray replicates per condition; seeds are nested. Small B count is not proof water unnecessary. Actual results cannot be manufactured from these fictional values.
task_solutions.GD6: Phaseolus vulgaris usually epigeal: hypocotyl raises cotyledonary node above marked soil; Pisum sativum hypogeal: epicotyl extends with cotyledons below. Cotyledons are seed leaves distinct from first true leaves. Dates/stages/actual visible landmarks required; unresolved marked not seen. A supplied model is not performed observation.
task_solutions.GD7: Apical primary extension/new primary tissues; lateral secondary girth. Typical woody vascular cambium secondary xylem inward/phloem outward; cork cambium protective periderm. Primary and secondary coexist in different regions/stages. Typical many eudicots/gymnosperms, not universal stems/plants; seasonal rings need suitable context.
task_solutions.GD8: Interval cm/day rates0,0.5,1,1,0.5; overall0.6. Water/oxygen/suitable temperature and species-specific light for germination; reserves initially supply resources; later photosynthesis/light and external mineral supply matter. Longer etiolated shoot is not higher biomass/health. No universal more heat/fertilizer benefit.
task_solutions.GD9: Auxin shoot elongation/tropism, gibberellins suitable germination/stem elongation, cytokinins division/shoot context, ABA dormancy/stomatal closure, ethylene ripening/abscission. These are representative roles with dose/tissue/species/stage/interacting-hormone qualifications, not one-to-one universal accelerators; no application.
task_solutions.GD10: Require all three distinct growth/development, species-specific dormancy, hormone claims with evidence/limits, followed by one useful qualified benefit. Print evidence is reasoning, observed digital search/view/save separately documented. No personal upload/login/download/contact.
task_solutions.GD11: All eight claims are false: swelling != new tissue; nonemergence != dormancy; waterlogging confounded; bean species differ; primary+secondary coexist; seed reserves/species light; hormones context dependent; reading != performed action. Useful establishment/monitoring decision must state a mechanism and limit.
task_solutions.GD12_I1_I2: FinalM70/90/80%=80%; FinalD0/0/10%=10/3%; difference230/3 percentage points. Matched lot/count/tray/light/time/room temperature, replicate/raw daily checks; no cooler group and no independent temperature/light/oxygen conclusion. Bean/pea classifications and regions as GD6; supplied descriptions cannot certify actual comparison.
task_solutions.I3: Typical apical length versus lateral girth and xylem inward/phloem outward; at least two stage-qualified resource/environment factors; all five hormones with roles and interaction/context limit.
task_solutions.I4: Specific species-aware establishment/timing/monitoring benefit with condition/measurement limit; actual named setup/count/moisture/temp/record/check plus multi-day logs F4/F5, actual dated specimen/sketch/check F6. Written data/long shoot alone insufficient; appreciation response does not prove lasting disposition.
